rationale: The fault on branch 'l23' is isolated by opening it. To restore service to the de-energized section, the available tie switch 'tie_24' is closed, re-energizing bus 'b4'. This results in a radial network. Bus 'b3' cannot be restored as it is isolated by the fault and has no alternate tie point. This plan maximizes restored load (90 kW) and priority (5) under the given topology, though it does not meet the `min_priority_restored` of 10.0, which appears to be impossible with the available switches.
